failed_or_abandoned: Run 2: full-grid (38 delta) 12-day annual-halo bracket exceeded the 600 s foreground limit; the process was moved to the background and killed before caching. Replaced by a 9-point delta grid (300-385 keV) with an incremental cache (run 3).

Initial 'fraction of LZ interval excluded' mixed this work's N_unit (Sun-frame halo) with P021's kappa_hat (annual halo), giving 0 near the ceiling; redefined normalisation-consistently using P021's own kappa_hat and edges (Sec. 3.2 of details.md).
No data request filed: HEPData efficiency tables of XENONnT/PandaX-4T end at their ROI edges and cannot supply the 200-300 keV acceptance.
